simple.summary: מַעֲרָךְ (maʻărâk) means an arrangement , i.e. (figuratively) mental disposition First listed occurrence: Prov 16 1.

definitions.full: H4633. maarak [ מַעֲרָךְ ] noun [masculine] arrangement ; — plural construct מַעַרְכֵיסּלֵב Prov 16:1 to man belong arrangements (plans) of the mind (compare לֵב 3 ).
